'''2009 Worlds Day 2 Geoff Dearing LS Quiet Mining Colony''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Geoff Dearing]] at [[2009 World Championship]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation]]
* '''Username:''' gdearing
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
